The '''satellite control tower''' of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] was located on the [[Markaran Plains]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. It was attacked by Republic forces under [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Finley]] around [[3642 BBY]].
